card.band: 4h. Frontier agents get the YIQ math and PNG right; the anti-aliasing heuristic, JPEG and TIFF decoding exactness and diff-mask details separate trials. Buckets by format and option. A weaker model fails on non-PNG formats and anti-aliasing.
card.cheat: Per-pixel RGB equality fails the threshold and anti-aliasing cases. Wrapping an installed image library is blocked because none ships in the image, and the odiff binary is sealed.
card.grading: Hidden pairs of generated images with controlled perturbations and the real odiff outputs recorded offline: exit code, differing-pixel count and diff-mask PNG pixels (exact). The pair count is in the hundreds, from a generator.
card.reference: Upstream odiff gives the expected outputs; our reference is a port of its core and decoders (about 1500 lines).
card.task: /app ships a stub CLI and a spec. The agent builds an image comparison tool in C or Rust, with no external image libraries. It needs PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF decoders, YIQ perceptual delta with a threshold, anti-aliasing detection, ignore regions, layout-difference handling, a diff-image writer and exit codes.

source_notes: Very fast SIMD-first image comparison library (with nodejs API)

facts.claim: odiff repo is MIT-licensed, written in Zig with SIMD (SSE2/AVX2/AVX512/NEON), originally OCaml
odiff README lists input support for .png, .jpeg, .jpg, .webp, .tiff; diff output only .png
YIQ NTSC perceptual difference, antialiasing option (AA pixels not counted), threshold 0-1 option
odiff build.zig.zon declares a single dependency, imgz pinned at commit 4d77943
Reference decoders are an in-house port of about 1500 lines covering PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF
imgz (the only odiff dependency) wraps libjpeg-turbo, libspng, libtiff and libwebp, not hand-written decoders
imgz documents bit-exact output or its IDCT / chroma upsampling method
odiff is distributed as an npm CLI binary (odiff-bin) and GitHub release binaries

full_card.band: Seed says 4h. Scope (4 decoders, YIQ, AA, ignore regions, layout, PNG writer, options) is about 3000 lines; excellent frontier agent est. 12 h. Tier 20 fits. Band 3 without dated public evidence.
full_card.build_cost: About 3 days: build odiff, record outputs for a generator, pin decoder behaviour. smoke_build was empty ({}), so no offline build result exists.
full_card.deliverable: C or Rust CLI: PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF decoders, YIQ delta with threshold, AA detection, ignore regions, layout-difference handling, diff-PNG writer, exit codes.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Per-pixel RGB equality fails threshold/AA cases. No image library in the image. odiff binary sealed: the npm package is not installable offline. Grading uses recorded outputs, so an agent cannot call odiff at run time.
full_card.grading_surface: Hundreds of generated image pairs with recorded odiff outputs: exit code, differing-pixel count, diff-mask PNG pixels (exact). Good surface size, but exact JPEG/TIFF pixels depend on libjpeg-turbo/libtiff arithmetic.
full_card.local_fit: gVisor fine: CPU-only, no network at run time, under 8 cores/16 GB. Zig/C/Rust toolchain needed.
full_card.lookup: partial: odiff source and npm binary are public; the algorithm is known in outline; not offline-installable; 3 open PRs unchecked.
full_card.provenance: github.com/dmtrKovalenko/odiff @ v4.5.0 (MIT, Zig, 3278 stars, not fork, not archived). Reference decoders come from the imgz dependency, which wraps C libraries.
full_card.reference: Upstream odiff (Zig) plus imgz. A port must reproduce libjpeg-turbo and libtiff decoding exactly. The claimed 1500-line port is unverified and does not match the wrapper structure.
full_card.ships: Stub CLI, spec, and a history-less snapshot of odiff source is NOT advisable: the public repo makes the algorithm recallable in outline. The bundle would need to ship a pinned spec and generator only.
full_card.similarity: Nearest l0: S-im-090 0.264, S-im-015 0.209, S-im-038 0.206, png-generation 0.178. Not crowded. Differs by a multi-format image diff tool with exact odiff parity.

v1.kill_reason: As seeded, exact JPEG/TIFF pixel masks depend on libjpeg-turbo/libtiff decoder arithmetic (imgz wraps C libraries). A different valid decoder would fail the hidden cases, so the gate that a different valid solution must pass fails. Revivable if the spec pins the decoder arithmetic exactly or JPEG/TIFF are graded with a tolerance. Also: the seed's reference-size and 4h band claims are contradicted.

Band.why: Large scope, but no dated public evidence; the seed's 4h tier is too short.

Build.why: About 3 days; the smoke build was not run and wrapped C decoders add cost.

Hor.why: Multi-module, about 12 h of frontier work; needs a tier 20 budget.

Lic.why: MIT for odiff; imgz's wrapped C libs are permissive; wrapper licence needs a check.

Multi.why: Formats, options and diff outputs give many partial-credit buckets.

Real.why: Popular MIT repo at a release tag with real source and tests.

Ref.why: Reference is a Zig port that wraps C decoders; the 1500-line claim is contradicted by imgz.

Seal.why: Binary sealed and grading offline, but the public Zig source is recallable in outline.

Surf.why: Hundreds of generated pairs with recorded outputs, exact pixel masks.

spike_plan.kill_if: Outputs are non-deterministic, or no spec-pinnable decoder arithmetic gives exact agreement for JPEG/TIFF.
spike_plan.pass_if: odiff builds offline-reproducibly, outputs are deterministic, and one pinned decoder arithmetic reproduces the recorded outputs exactly for PNG and JPEG/TIFF.
steps: In a throwaway networked container, clone odiff at v4.5.0 and build the CLI with Zig (smoke_build was empty, so this is the first build).
Generate about 50 PNG/JPEG/TIFF pairs with controlled perturbations and record odiff exit code, diff count and diff-mask PNG pixels.
Run the build twice on the same pairs and confirm byte-identical outputs (determinism).
Check the JPEG path: decode 20 JPEGs with libjpeg-turbo ISLOW IDCT and no fancy upsampling, and with the default settings, and count per-pixel mismatches against imgz output.
Check the TIFF path the same way with libtiff for 10 files (compression variants).
Decide: if JPEG/TIFF mismatches are zero only under one pinned arithmetic, write that arithmetic into the spec; otherwise grade JPEG/TIFF with a tolerance or drop exact pixel masks for those formats.

v1.summary: The idea is a real, MIT-licensed odiff parity task with a large, recordable grading surface, but the seed's reference description is wrong: the decoders come from imgz, which wraps libjpeg-turbo, libspng, libtiff and libwebp, so exact JPEG/TIFF masks are not a spec-defined target. It also needs a tier 20 budget (about 12 frontier hours), not 4h, and the smoke build is empty, so the spike must confirm offline build and decoder determinism before revival.
